messages:
Aisha: Quick check — CI flakes on py-sdk tests only on Python 3.8 in GH Actions. mypy errors + streaming test timeouts. Anyone seen this?
Matt: I hit that on my branch yesterday. Feels like a deps/resolver mismatch between pip and poetry (poetry lock pins httpx/httpcore).
Tanya: Can you paste the failing trace?
Aisha: Sure — copy paste:```
mypy: error: Cannot find implementation or library stub for module 'httpcore._exceptions'
tests/test_streaming.py::test_async_stream FAILED — Timeout after 5s
```
Kevin: Sounds like httpcore stubs are missing. Poetry lock keeps httpcore==0.14.x for us; pip on GH might be pulling 0.24. Try pinning httpx/httpcore in test-requirements.txt. Also ensure typing-extensions is installed for py<=3.9.
Matt: For the streaming timeout: CI runner sometimes uses a different event loop policy on 3.8. Our fixture uses a plain asyncio loop — could try setting `asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.DefaultEventLoopPolicy())` in the test setup or bump timeout.
Tanya: Also confirm tests use `async for chunk in client.stream(...):` (async generator) — mixing sync iteration with async stream can hang.
Aisha: Auth note — some tests rely on REDWOOD_API_KEY secret. Deploy bot rotated the key yesterday so a few ephemeral tests errored until Actions secret was updated. I switched to monkeypatching os.environ in the fixture to avoid races.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rotated test API key at 2025-02-09T08:12Z — secret updated in GH Actions.
Kevin: Proposed action items: (1) add typing-extensions to CI (py<=3.9) (2) add explicit httpx/httpcore constraints in test-requirements.txt to match poetry lock (3) change streaming fixture to use `async for` and increase timeout to 20s (4) make tests monkeypatch REDWOOD_API_KEY instead of depending on secret timing. I'll open a PR with the changes.
Aisha: :thumbsup: I'll rerun my branch after the PR. If flakes persist I'll file a dedicated issue with the failing run link.
Tanya: Can someone add a short note in CONTRIBUTING about "pip local dev vs poetry lock" — it's confusing for new contributors.
Matt: I'll add a one-paragraph note + exact reproduce command: `python -m pip install -r test-requirements.txt && pytest tests/streaming -k test_async_stream`.
Aisha: Thanks all — will follow up once CI finishes on my PR.
